disorder-name.detail: DSM-5 Cannabis Use Disorder; adults seeking treatment for cannabis use, recruited from two clinical trials (varenicline trial NCT02892110 and TMS trial NCT03144232) at the Medical University of South Carolina.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "individuals had to be seeking treatment for cannabis use, meet criteria for DSM-5 CUD"

dataset-of-origin.detail: All participants were recruited from two clinical trials conducted at the Medical University of South Carolina (MUSC), a single institutional site. No publicly named dataset.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "The present study used pre-treatment baseline data from two clinical trials for CUD at the Medical University of South Carolina."

age.detail: Overall clinical cohort (N=72). Mean and SD reported directly in Results; range reported in Results.
